subject: Re: Next steps — AcmeHealth private VPC discovery & network constraints
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmehealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: AcmeHealth — private VPC discovery follow-up

Thanks for the call today, Marissa & Camila — good overview. A quick recap from our side and a few clarifying questions so we can move to the technical deep-dive: 

Pain points / goals we discussed:
- Data residency: PHI/PII must remain in AcmeHealth-controlled networks (US-only), need audit logs for access.
- Latency: Clinical UI needs <200ms tail latency for chat across our East Coast region.
- Security: Must support VPC-only access (no public internet egress from model servers), and ability to run in air-gapped mode for certain facilities.

Networking constraints / ask for Redwood:
1) Do you support PrivateLink / VPC endpoints for control plane? We cannot allow control-plane traffic over public egress.
2) Required outbound ports for model runtime and kernel updates — we need a list of IPs/ports for our firewall team.
3) Can Redwood run in our on-prem air-gapped cluster if needed for high-regulation sites? If so, what are the ops dependencies (images, licensing, update channels)?

Next steps from AcmeHealth: we will pull together our network contact (IT Ops) and schedule a technical session with your solutions engineer. Also attaching a basic network checklist that the security team requested.

Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of Platform Engineering, AcmeHealth
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AcmeHealth — private VPC discovery follow-up

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. Below are answers and confirmation of next steps; I included Camila for the deep-dive.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Control plane: Yes — we offer a Private control plane option that can be configured to use AWS PrivateLink or Private Service Connect (GCP). This allows the management/control-plane traffic to stay on your VPC or peer-connected networks.
- Outbound requirements: We will provide a consolidated list of egress IP ranges and ports. For the hosted control plane we have small egress needs (TLS to our update hosts) — for Dedicated/Private we can operate with no public egress if you choose the air-gapped on-prem package.
- Air-gapped/on-prem: We support an on-prem air-gapped deployment; it requires an initial artifact bundle (container images and a signed update package) and a short bootstrap connectivity window to Redwood to validate licensing, but daily ops can be fully air-gapped. Camila will outline the process and timelines in the technical session.

Attachments: I attached a short VPC architecture sketch and our standard network checklist (redwood-private-vpc-architecture.pdf, acme-network-checklist.xlsx).

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive with Camila (solutions engineer) + your IT Ops and Security — proposed times: Thu Jun 3 10:00am PT or Fri Jun 4 11:00am PT.
2) We will send a short network/ports/IP checklist for your firewall team before the call.
3) You share your compliance worksheet (if you have a SOC2/NIST packet) so our compliance team can pre-check.

I can take the 10am PT slot on Thu, Camila can do either. Priya — are you able to join the deep-dive?

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Alex / IT Ops team — Camila here from Redwood Solutions. Looking forward to the technical session. A few items I'll cover and what I'd like from your side so we can be efficient: 

Agenda I plan to cover (45-60m):
- Deployment options overview: Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private (VPC/on-prem air-gapped)
- Networking patterns: control plane options (PrivateLink), data plane (in-VPC model serving), and recommended firewall rules
- Ops and update model for air-gapped sites (artifact bundles, licensing validation windows, optional HSM/KMS integrations)
- Demo: sample VPC peering + how we handle KV cache/backplane traffic

Info request from AcmeHealth (to send before the call):
- Network diagram or VPC CIDR ranges for the environment you plan to use (screenshot or simple doc is fine).
- Any egress policy constraints (strict denylist vs allowlist).
- Compliance packet (SOC2/NIST) or specific control gaps to pre-review.

I've penciled you in for Thu Jun 3 10:00am PT — if that works we'll send a calendar invite with a short dial-in and a small pre-read. If you prefer Fri Jun 4 11:00am PT, say the word.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
